query:
I have this JSON — how do I get just the email addresses on the command line?
```json
[{"id":1,"name":"Alice","email":"alice@example.com"},{"id":2,"name":"Bob","email":"bob@example.com"}]
```

From this API response, extract only the items where status is active:
```json
{"items":[{"id":1,"status":"active"},{"id":2,"status":"inactive"},{"id":3,"status":"active"}]}
```

How do I count the number of objects in this JSON array from the shell?
```json
[{"x":1},{"x":2},{"x":3},{"x":4}]
```

Sort this JSON output by the created_at field and show me the latest two:
```json
[{"id":1,"created_at":"2024-01-10"},{"id":2,"created_at":"2024-03-01"},{"id":3,"created_at":"2024-02-15"}]
```

Convert this JSON list of records into a CSV file:
```json
[{"name":"Alice","age":30,"city":"NYC"},{"name":"Bob","age":25,"city":"LA"}]
```

Pull the third element out of this JSON array in bash:
```json
["apple","banana","cherry","date"]
```

Merge these two JSON objects into one at the command line:
```json
{"a":1,"b":2}
```
and
```json
{"c":3,"d":4}
```

Filter this JSON document by a deeply nested field value:
```json
{"users":[{"profile":{"region":"us-west"},"name":"Alice"},{"profile":{"region":"eu"},"name":"Bob"}]}
```
Keep only `region == "us-west"`.

Get the keys of every object in this JSON array:
```json
[{"id":1,"name":"x"},{"id":2,"score":99}]
```

Group these JSON records by the kind field and count each group:
```json
[{"kind":"bug"},{"kind":"feat"},{"kind":"bug"},{"kind":"docs"},{"kind":"feat"}]
```

I'm piping the output of `gh pr list --json number,title` and need only the numbers:
```json
[{"number":42,"title":"fix login"},{"number":43,"title":"add dark mode"}]
```

How do I compute the average of the `score` field across this JSON array?
```json
[{"name":"a","score":80},{"name":"b","score":90},{"name":"c","score":70}]
```
How do I parse a YAML config file in bash?
Extract the third column from a CSV file on the command line.
How do I read a TOML file from a shell script?
Get all elements from an XML document via the command line.
How do I parse JSON inside a Python script using the standard library?
Filter rows in a SQL table where the country is 'US'.
Pretty-print a JavaScript object in the Node REPL.
How do I read JSON in Go without unmarshaling into a struct?
